projects.name: Professional (PMP) | Project Management Institute (PMI)
details: • PMI Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP) | Project Management Institute (PMI)
• Certified SAFe 5 Scrum Master | Certified SAFe 4 Agilist - Scaled Agile Framework
• ITIL v3 Foundation in Service Management | Lean Six Sigma White Belt (LSSWB)
CORE COMPETENCIES & EXPERTISE
• Banking & Fintech Domain : Cards & Digital Payments (Credit/Prepaid, Apple Pay), Network
Mandates (VISA, Mastercard, AMEX, Discover),  Fraud/AML Prevention, PEP and OFAC compliance,
Account Servicing & Modernization, Basel II/III Compliance.
• End-to-End Project Management: Full SDLC Delivery, Scope & Budget Management, Risk Baseline
& RAID Management, Resource Capacity Planning, Executive Stakeholder Management, Vendor &
Partner Alignment.
• Agile & SAFe Delivery : Scaled Agile Framework, Scrum, Kanban, Multi -Squad PI Planning, ART
Syncs, Scrum of Scrums, Sprint Predictability & Velocity Optimization.
• Digital Transformation & Architecture: Digital Customer Journeys, Self-Service Account Servicing,
Legacy-to-RESTful API Modernization, Microservices, Security & Step -Up Authentication (MFA,
3DS2), Card Tokenization, Authorization and Settlements, CI/CD DevOps Collaboration.
• PMO & AI Automation : Custom Generative AI/Copilot PMO Agents, Jira, Azure DevOps (ADO),
Planview, Clarity, Rally, Executive Governance Dashboards.

projects.name: / Agile Delivery Lead Jan 2017 – Mar 2021
details: • Operationalized SAFe frameworks across 15+ global teams (120+ engineers), driving an average
20–25% increase in release velocity and reducing release cycle turnaround from quarterly to bi-weekly.
• Facilitated large -scale Agile Release Train (ART) syncs, quarterly Inspect & Adapt workshops,
System Demos, and Scrum of Scrums for distributed teams across India and the US delivery centers.
• Elevated sprint commitment-to-delivery ratios from 65% to 88% and cut cycle time by 18% using
data-driven retrospectives and Agile metric governance.
• Directed delivery for high -visibility digital initiatives including Apple Pay network tokenization rollout
and specialized merchant spend-filtering platforms for Walmart.
FIS Global Business Solutions | Chennai, India

projects.name: Aug 2013 – Apr 2014
details: • Managed technical delivery roadmaps for a dedicated banking technology center supporting
multi-million-dollar accounts.
• Governed end -to-end regulatory compliance and risk management initiatives, including Basel II/III
and Dodd-Frank regulatory reporting pipelines.
Dun & Bradstreet (D&B) | Chennai, India
Associate Manager - Projects Jun 2008 – Jul 2013
• Delivered 4 international Credit Bureau  platforms (Commercial, Consumer, Mortgage, Micro-Finance)
for Central Banks across international jurisdictions (Oman, Qatar, Libya, Nigeria) under World
Bank/IFC mandates.
• Structured end -to-end PMO governance, milestone tracking, and stakeholder reporting across
distributed engineering, QA, and BA teams.
• Recognized with CEO and Customer Excellence Awards for on -time, within -budget international
program delivery.
EARLY CAREER HISTORY
• ICEGEN Computing | Project Manager / System Analyst (Nov 2003 – May 2008)
Led technical project execution for enterprise client solutions, including asset-tracking systems for
global financial clients (HSBC, Standard Chartered).
• BIOSOFT | System Analyst (Jan 2000 – Nov 2003)
Handled legacy software modernization and client-server migrations.
